title: ChessPlusPlus Game Configuration
description: Configuration schema for a hex-grid tactics game. Uses axial coordinates (q, r). Matches DEFAULT_CONFIG in server/game/engine/config_loader.py and client config.service.ts.

version.description: Configuration format version. Version 1.0 imports are migrated before validation.

radius.description: Hex grid radius (distance from centre hex to edge). The default board is radius 11 (12 cells per hexagon edge).

orientation.description: Cosmetic: how the client draws the board hexagon. Default is edge-up.

units.description: Unit type definitions, keyed by unit id.

display.description: Per-colour display glyphs rendered on the board.

move.description: Number of adjacent-hex steps this unit can move per turn. Movement floods outward through the six hex neighbours. A unit walks through its own - an ally costs a step to pass but is not somewhere to stop - while an enemy blocks the hex and the way past it alike.

value.description: Unit worth in UP, also used for phase loss scoring.

hp.description: Maximum hit points for this unit type.

attack.description: Attack before defense. An integer uses rules.rangeFalloff beyond the first ring. A list supplies exact attack for rings attackMinRange through attackRange, ignoring rangeFalloff; it must have one entry per supported ring, at most four.

commander.description: This unit is the side's commander. Under the 'regicide' objective, losing every commander loses the game. Omitted means false.

attackRange.description: Outermost ring this unit can strike, by hex distance and ignoring obstacles. Scalar attack falls off by rules.rangeFalloff per ring beyond 1; a list gives each supported ring its own attack. Omitted means 1.

attackMinRange.description: Innermost ring this unit can strike or counterattack. Must not exceed attackRange. Omitted means 1. An attack list starts at this ring.

defense.description: Flat damage reduction applied when this unit is attacked. strike_damage() subtracts it from the incoming attack, floored at 0.

ability.description: Catalogue id of this unit type's own ability, cast from the Unit panel onto the unit itself - so it must be a 'friendly' one. Paid from its side's purse like the same ability anywhere else; its cooldown and uses are the unit's own. Omitted means the unit has none.

heal.description: Healing amount at distances 1 through the number of entries. Replaces this unit’s attack action: heal one other friendly battlefield unit, optionally after moving, capped at its max HP, with no CP cost. At most four adjacent hex rings. Omitted means this unit has no healing action.

captureZones.description: Zones this unit can capture or neutralize: home is its own 3x zone, enemy the opposing 3x zone, middle the 2x zone, side either 1x zone. Empty means none; omitted means unrestricted for older configs. Permissions also determine which enemies can prevent full-zone control from the centre.

veterancy.description: Permanent stats unlocked at vet 1. hp, move, defense and scalar attack are additive; an attack list replaces the base profile. attackRange, attackMinRange and heal replace the corresponding base field. Current and maximum HP each rise by hp once, without reviving dead units. Omitted means no first-star stat change.

attack.description: Scalar adds to every attack tier; a list replaces the profile at vet 1.

attackRange.description: Outermost ring this unit can strike, by hex distance and ignoring obstacles. Scalar attack falls off by rules.rangeFalloff per ring beyond 1; a list gives each supported ring its own attack. Omitted means 1.

attackMinRange.description: Innermost ring this unit can strike or counterattack. Must not exceed attackRange. Omitted means 1. An attack list starts at this ring.

heal.description: Healing amount at distances 1 through the number of entries. Replaces this unit’s attack action: heal one other friendly battlefield unit, optionally after moving, capped at its max HP, with no CP cost. At most four adjacent hex rings. Omitted means this unit has no healing action.

passive.description: Catalogue id of the unit passive unlocked at Vet 2. Omitted means none. Unit passives currently execute in solo play.

abilities.description: The ability catalogue and how a side gets at it. Keyed by a STABLE id throughout - never by position - because a side's saved loadout, path and cooldowns are written by id, and a reordered list would otherwise re-point every one of them. The engine still does not read abilities; the client does, and this is where their numbers live so that tuning one is a config edit.

slots.description: How many pool abilities a side may carry at once. Picks come in pairs, so this is even.

pool.description: Catalogue ids a side picks its loadout from, in pairs: the first two are one pick, the next two another. An even number of them.

paths.description: The ways a side can specialise. One per match.

passive.description: Catalogue id, granted free with the path. Always on: only its mov/atk/def mean anything.

ultimate.description: Catalogue id. Once a match unless its catalogue entry sets `uses`.

utility.description: Catalogue id for the path action replacing Reselect. Omitted preserves the legacy pair swap.

catalogue.description: Every ability, keyed by its own id.

description.description: Displayed explanation. Numeric templates resolve from this entry: {cost}, {sign:atk}, {abs:mov}, {duration}, {scope}, {radius}, {passiveUnlock}, {homeRows}, {counterProfile}. Custom literal text is kept.

target.description: What a cast is aimed at. 'universal' needs no target and grants points. 'all-enemies' needs no target and changes stats on the enemy battlefield and green reserve units present when cast. Red base units and later arrivals are excluded; affected units keep the effect when returning to base. 'hex' selects any rendered hex, including empty and panel hexes; recipients are captured at casting. 'pair' selects a carried pool pair.

cost.description: Cast cost: points for the pool and legacy unit abilities, UP for Vet 3 unit effects, CP for paths.

cooldown.description: How many of its side's turns it cannot be cast again for after a cast. Omitted means 3.

turns.description: How many caster turns a temporary stat or status effect lasts. It expires at that caster's turn start after this many full turns. Omitted means 1. Damage, healing, promotion, recharge and points happen immediately.

uses.description: Maximum casts per match, or per phase with usesScope phase; per side for panel abilities and per unit for unit abilities. Omitted means unlimited, except a path ultimate defaults to one.

damage.description: HP taken off the target. Enemy abilities only.

heal.description: HP given back to the target, up to its maximum. Friendly abilities only.

points.description: Points the cast hands its caster - always points, whichever currency bought the ability. Universal abilities only.

testing.description: Marks a testing/catalogue entry such as Rally. The shipped pool excludes it; this marker alone does not restrict a configured custom ability online.

effect.description: Configured unit or CP path behavior, executed in solo and authoritative multiplayer. Capture unlocks at Vet 2: a sole capturing side holds the zone except eligible enemy occupants; opposing active Capture passives restore normal claims.

counterAttack.description: Counter ATK by distance, starting at ring 1, before DEF and ability modifiers.

up.description: UP granted by Sacrifice, independently of its UP cost.

enemyDamage.description: Immediate enemy HP damage from Call.

enemyAtk.description: Enemy ATK change from Call for one full turn.

enemyDef.description: Enemy DEF change from Call for one full turn.

minVet.description: Minimum rank for a path passive. Omitted preserves the legacy first-star gate.

stars.description: Immediate permanent stars granted by Strengthen or selected Sacrifice, capped at vet 3. On Sacrifice, this opts into one friendly battlefield/green-reserve recipient, full healing, and an optional unused friendly battlefield extra actor; omission preserves legacy army-wide Sacrifice.

recharge.description: Cooldown removed from each half of a carried pair. Positive cooldowns stop at 1; already-ready abilities stay at 0.

splashDamage.description: Direct HP damage to occupants of the six hexes adjacent to the chosen hex.

splashAtk.description: ATK modifier for adjacent hex recipients.

splashMov.description: MOV modifier for adjacent hex recipients.

setAtk.description: Set the existing stat to this value; subsequent modifiers apply after the latest setting. Does not grant an absent attack/healing profile.

enemyDefSet.description: Absolute DEF assigned to enemy recipients, overriding temporary DEF modifiers.

scope.description: Recipient zones for selected friendly/enemy casts, path passives and path effects. field-reserve excludes red bases; all (or omitted scope on a selected cast) includes every zone. Passives also apply to later eligible arrivals; temporary casts capture only current recipients.

hel.description: Temporary modifier to each ring of an existing normal healing profile.

setHel.description: Set the existing stat to this value; subsequent modifiers apply after the latest setting. Does not grant an absent attack/healing profile.

splashHel.description: Healing modifier for adjacent hex recipients.

usesScope.description: Scope of the uses budget. Omitted means match. Phase means initialization, each numbered phase including halftime/postmatch, or all overtime stages together; requires uses.

area.description: Horizontal board-wide line for hex-cleave, or four diagonal rays for hex-trap. Omitted preserves the legacy radial area. The shape includes base/reserve cells and follows board orientation.

splashRange.description: Nearest steps receiving the splash effect; omitted means one. Line areas count cells along the line.

outerRange.description: Last ring reached by hex-sap, beyond splashRange. Omitted reaches only splashRange.

outerAtk.description: Nonnegative ATK boost to hex-sap outer-ring occupants on either side; requires outerRange.

outerHel.description: Nonnegative HEL boost to existing healers in hex-sap outer ring on either side; requires outerRange.

outerMov.description: Nonnegative MOV boost on hex-trap outer diagonal rays beyond splashRange; requires cross area.

radius.description: Call effect range in adjacent hex steps, excluding the caster. Omitted preserves the older army-wide Call.

enemyMov.description: Temporary MOV modifier to enemy recipients of a unit Call.

pairPickDelay.description: Full turns after a side first picks a pool pair before it can fill a second pair. A pick on Turn 1 with delay 5 unlocks on Turn 6. Omitted preserves immediate picking in older configs.

white.description: Map of 'q,r' coordinate strings to unit type ids for white. A battlefield hex stands the unit on the board; a hex of white's own panels (the bottom two: base bottom-left, reserve bottom-right) deals it into that panel - the default puts each side's base squad there. A hex in the other side's panels, or a commander in any panel, is refused.

black.description: Map of 'q,r' coordinate strings to unit type ids for black. A battlefield hex stands the unit on the board; a hex of black's own panels (the top two: base top-right, reserve top-left) deals it into that panel - the default puts each side's base squad there. A hex in the other side's panels, or a commander in any panel, is refused.

match.description: Schedule, clock, victory predicates and starting CP. Every match saves its resolved values.

objective.description: Regicide loses the side's commanders; elimination loses all surviving units, including panels.

turnTimeLimit.description: Seconds per side's turn; 0 disables the clock. The room's clock choice overrides this when starting an online match.

maxTurns.description: Maximum individual side turns (plies), not White+Black full turns. 0 disables the limit.

cpAtStart.description: Starting CP before any phase award.

opening.description: Initial deployment stage. turns counts full White-plus-Black turns.

name.description: Displayed label; it does not select gameplay behavior.

turns.description: Duration in full White-plus-Black turns (two plies). Ability effects instead count caster turns.

pointsPerTurn.description: Regular points credited when this side starts its own turn; phase entries use this rate after halftime, or throughout when halftime is disabled.

grant.description: Additional regular points on each side's first turn of this stage, once.

items.description: Full turns of play, followed by postmatchTurns. halftimeAfter=0 disables halftime; otherwise income changes after that many full turns. Phase references are one-based.

name.description: Displayed label; it does not select gameplay behavior.

turns.description: Duration in full White-plus-Black turns (two plies). Ability effects instead count caster turns.

halftimeAfter.description: Full turns before the halftime transition and UP snapshot; 0 disables halftime. Must not exceed turns.

postmatchTurns.description: Full postmatch turns after the numbered phase; 0 resolves its tally at the next phase boundary.

pointsPerTurn.description: Regular points on each own turn from halftime until play ends; when halftimeAfter is 0, applies throughout the phase.

grant.description: Additional regular points on each side's first turn of this stage, once.

vpMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied after capture worth minus weighted attrition, with the configured score floor.

cpAward.description: Fixed CP credited once with this phase's tally, in addition to the weighted score and deficit portions.

pointsBeforeHalftime.description: Regular points on each own turn before halftime. Ignored when halftime is disabled.

postmatchPointsPerTurn.description: Regular points on each own postmatch turn.

phases.description: Ordered numbered phases; any nonempty count. Each entry specifies a complete phase.

overtime.description: Ordered overtime stages entered when the final points decision does not finish the match.

name.description: Displayed label; it does not select gameplay behavior.

pointsPerTurn.description: Regular points credited when this side starts its own turn; phase entries use this rate after halftime, or throughout when halftime is disabled.

name.description: Displayed label; it does not select gameplay behavior.

turns.description: Duration in full White-plus-Black turns (two plies). Ability effects instead count caster turns.

kingToll.description: Direct HP lost by the acting side's commanders at the end of each own overtime turn. Fortress can prevent it.

moves.description: Independent distinct-unit action allowances for battlefield, reserve and base. Opening arrays need one value per opening turn.

battlefield.description: Distinct battlefield units allowed to act in one own turn.

reserve.description: Distinct green-reserve units allowed to act in one own turn.

base.description: Distinct red-base units allowed to act in one own turn.

stages.description: Ordered overtime stages; any nonempty count. Each specifies its duration, king toll and all three action limits.

winConditions.description: Existing ending predicates and their numeric thresholds. This does not define new predicates.

phase.description: One-based numbered phase index; must exist in match.phases.

side.description: Side tested for this pending loss.

condition.description: no-eligible-capture-occupant compares eligible occupied capture hex count; vp-at-most compares phase VP.

threshold.description: Inclusive maximum occupancy or VP that triggers this pending loss.

earlyPhaseLosses.description: Phase-specific pending losses frozen at tally and resolved after its postmatch; regicide takes priority.

points.description: Final cumulative VP decision after the last numbered phase's postmatch.

enabled.description: Whether the final VP lead can win outright; disabled always continues to overtime.

leadToWin.description: Maximum lead that still forces overtime, keyed by the leading side. A strictly larger lead wins on points.

overtimeWinner.description: Winner after all configured overtime turns if no earlier result: white, black or draw.

stageRules.description: Independent permissions for each stage. A permission opens a category; its existing targeting, kit, price and action checks still apply.

normalHeal.description: Allow ordinary healing, independently of attacks. Only battlefield sources can perform normal healing.

unitAbilities.description: Allow configured active unit abilities if rank, zone and action checks pass.

cpUtilities.description: Allow path utilities such as Convert, Strengthen and Recharge.

cpSkills.description: Allow path skills such as Drain, Cleave and Trap.

cpUltimates.description: Allow path ultimates such as Fortress, Ruin and Blitz.

reserveEntry.description: Open reserve entry into the battlefield's home rows; entry still ends that unit's action.

homecoming.description: Open battlefield withdrawals into a red base through the configured home rows and doorways.

movedUnitsLockedInOpening.description: Keep units that moved in any earlier opening turn unavailable for the remainder of the opening.

economy.description: Starting purses and multipliers for existing transactions. Recorded prices/refunds are not repriced later.

pointsAtStart.description: Starting regular ability points, before ordinary own-turn income.

upAtStart.description: Starting unit points (UP), before deployment or unit-ability spending.

killPayMultiplier.description: UP bounty multiplier for ordinary attack/counter kills in eligible exchange zones; ability kills remain exempt.

killPayZones.description: Exchange target zones eligible for UP combat bounties, including its counter casualty. Empty disables these bounties.

walkHomeRefund.description: Refund at withdrawal: max(minimum, unit value × valueMultiplier − fee − missing HP × missingHpMultiplier). Original owner receives it.

valueMultiplier.description: Unit-value multiplier in the withdrawal refund.

fee.description: Fixed UP deduction from the withdrawal refund.

missingHpMultiplier.description: UP deducted per currently missing HP at withdrawal.

minimum.description: Minimum UP refund for a withdrawal.

wrapPriceMultiplier.description: UP multiplier on unit value when crossing from red base to green reserve.

halftimeUpMultiplier.description: Multiplier on each side's current phase VP snapshot added to UP at halftime, once.

overtimeVpToPointsMultiplier.description: Multiplier on final cumulative numbered-phase VP converted to regular points on each side's first overtime turn.

cpOwnScoreMultiplier.description: CP paid per own phase VP at the tally.

cpOpponentScoreMultiplier.description: CP paid per opponent phase VP at the tally.

cpBehindGapMultiplier.description: Additional CP per VP of the deficit, only for the trailing side.

scoring.description: Capture geometry, claim reach and attrition scoring. Unit capture-tier eligibility remains in unit config.

layout.description: Board-radius proportions used by named relative zone anchors; absolute centres bypass them.

columnRatio.description: Side anchor columns as a fraction of board radius, rounded with Math.round semantics and kept outside the zone radius.

rowRatio.description: Home anchor rows as a fraction of board radius, rounded to whole row pairs.

kind.description: Unit capture permission tier: side/middle/base. This is independent of the geometric anchor.

owner.description: Home-side owner for base-tier zones; side/middle zones require the empty string.

anchor.description: Relative centre: middle, right, left, white-home or black-home. Supply exactly one of anchor and center.

center.description: Absolute battlefield axial [q,r] centre, instead of a relative anchor.

radius.description: Hex rings from the centre. Ability radius controls its existing effect footprint; 0 is centre-only where supported.

worth.description: VP worth of each held hex before losses and the phase multiplier.

zones.description: Capture zones; empty disables all capture scoring. Overlapping hexes use the greatest worth.

floorAtZero.description: Clamp capture worth minus weighted deaths to 0 before applying the phase multiplier; false permits negative VP.

deathCostMultiplier.description: Attrition VP deduction multiplier on each dead unit's configured value.

deathZones.description: Victim zones whose casualties contribute attrition; empty disables the deduction. Counters use the attacker's battlefield zone.

innerClaimReach.description: Claim radius for eligible units on inner layers outside the centre.

outerClaimReach.description: Claim radius for eligible units on the zone's outermost layer.

neutralizeReach.description: Radius in which eligible units neutralize opposing normal claims.

centerControl.description: An uncontested eligible centre occupant claims its entire zone; eligible enemies in that zone disable this bonus.

combat.description: Ordinary strike scaling, damage floors and counter permissions.

rangeFalloff.description: Linear loss per extra ring for scalar ATK; exact ring profiles do not use it.

minStrikeDamage.description: Minimum positive ordinary strike after DEF, capped by effective ATK; 0 lets armor absorb it fully.

minRangedDamage.description: Minimum positive scalar ATK after range falloff, capped by its original ATK.

counterattacks.description: Master counterattack permission; false suppresses all ordinary counters.

baseCounters.description: Allow red-base defenders to counter when otherwise eligible.

reserveCounters.description: Allow green-reserve defenders to counter when otherwise eligible.

panels.description: Crossing reach/cost and ordinary end-of-own-turn panel healing.

homeRows.description: Depth of home battlefield rows available for reserve entry, withdrawal and existing home-row positional effects.

crossingStepCost.description: MOV cost of a doorway/wrap step; at least 1.

baseHealPerTurn.description: HP mended at each own turn end while alive in red base, capped at current maximum HP.

reserveHealPerTurn.description: HP mended at each own turn end while alive in green reserve, capped at current maximum HP.

veterancy.description: Earned-star schedule, kit unlocks and zone activation. The rank cap remains 3.

startingRank.description: Stars assigned to each initially dealt unit in all zones.

statUnlock.description: Earned rank needed for the configured veterancy stat boost, 0–3.

passiveUnlock.description: Earned rank needed for the configured unit passive, 0–3.

abilityUnlock.description: Earned rank needed for the configured unit active ability, 0–3.

award.description: Stars added at each eligible award, capped at rank 3; 0 disables rank gain.

fullHealRank.description: Rank required before the full-heal award, so a same-boundary promotion does not newly qualify.

firstPhaseStartAward.description: Award both sides simultaneously at the first numbered phase start.

postmatchAwards.description: Award both sides simultaneously at every numbered phase's postmatch start, if that phase has a postmatch.

awardZones.description: Zones eligible for natural awards and the configured final full heal.

kitZones.description: Zones where earned veterancy stats, passives and unit active abilities function. Stars persist outside these zones.

anyOf.description: Full-heal postmatch: last means the final numbered phase, an integer selects a phase, 0 disables it.
Full-heal postmatch: last means the final numbered phase, an integer selects a phase, 0 disables it.

fullHealPhase.description: Full-heal postmatch: last means the final numbered phase, an integer selects a phase, 0 disables it.

ruleset.description: Balance preset identity independent of the config format. This is descriptive metadata, never a request to fetch current rules.

id.description: Stable preset label. Migrated format-1 imports use imported.

revision.description: null means draft. A numbered shipped preset revision requires owner approval.
